meta.notes: The app tags it "YUANDAO DSP Device". Its official presets: 1 Default (flat), 2 Tears, 3 Rock Live, 4 POP, 5 ACG, 6 Balance, 7 Tuned by DSP Master, 8 bands each, with pre-gains from -2 to +3 dB. The product name the device reports over USB is not known yet, so it matches by vendor and product id.
